bot.name: Pluto v2
bot.description: An all-race neural bot using the official md09b_1331000 model with a conservative ShieldBattery compatibility adapter. Experimental; human difficulty uncalibrated.

formats.notes: Two-player Melee with legacy limits; finite guard and gameplay evidence.

mapConstraints: Maps at most 128 by 128 tiles; legacy unit limits.
Windows x64 and AVX2 CPU required; inference helper is x64, game client is x86.

learning.notes: Per-opponent opening statistics persist in isolated profiles; reset restores empty read/write directories.

license.name: MIT companion with LGPL-3.0 BWAPI; original model downloaded separately
license.notes: Facility archive contains adapter and corresponding sources, not original Pluto binaries. Installer downloads pinned official release directly; no original-model redistribution grant is asserted.

localDistribution.evidence: Adapter-only package, retained MIT/LGPL notices and matching source; original models fetched directly from official publisher by client. See docs/pluto-catalog-admission.md.

publicCompetition.evidence: Local practice support does not establish public competition eligibility.

limitations: Requires SB Pluto v2 catalog runtime and in-process companion host.
Bounded fog and binary review; no full isolation certification.
Prior exact .10 natural Terran match and source-built utility/launch tests; catalog install gameplay evidence recorded separately.

sourceReview.evidence: Catalog Download/cancel/retry and production-mode launch with release game DLLs verified in docs/releases/pluto-sb-1.md; source admission remains pending maintainer review.
